'''J Company''', also known the '''Ninth Company''', was a unit in the [[Republic Army]] that fought in [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jojames]], the unit stopped an Imperial effort to drill into the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]
